comments.body_html:
Turns out that this mod comes pre-packaged with an outdated Bobby’s Music Player mod which doesn’t work and breaks your F12 menu. Installing the newest version of BMP fixes the issue.

OP should consider adding it as a pre-requisite requirement, instead of posting it pre-packaged to avoid issues like this in the future.
